opencode.description: Use for the OpenCode 2 release the app's client and plugin are built against: serve and service mode, service.json, pairing, the web UI, server auth, plugins and config. Move the branch with the @opencode/client and @opencode/plugin versions in package.json.

opentunnel.description: Use for OpenTunnel, behind OpenCode's remote access: where its identity and certificate are stored, and how routes and tunnels connect

supervisor.description: Use for app config.yaml options, Supervisor roles and API access, ingress, discovery, backups and app networking

dev-docs.description: Use for the Home Assistant app developer docs under docs/apps: configuration, communication, presentation, security and publishing

core.description: Use for Home Assistant Core APIs the app talks to: the MCP server integration, WebSocket and REST APIs, and hassio ingress

frontend.description: Use for how the Home Assistant frontend shows app panels and ingress iframes

docker-base.description: Use for Home Assistant base images: s6-overlay, bashio and the Debian and Alpine variants

triage.description: Use as the model Home Assistant app: config.yaml, ingress behind the Supervisor, the root app image target, prebuilt multi-arch GHCR images and the release workflow

music-assistant.description: Use for Music Assistant's WebSocket API and how its Home Assistant app exposes it, when connecting OpenCode to it
